water_animation.method: Flow-aligned geometry shape keys, broken cascade ribbons, periodic material phases and advecting foam. No simulation cache or claim of physically measured flow.

limitations: No publicly obtained lidar or centimeter terrain survey.
Water hydraulics are an authored cyclic representation; its physical fidelity requires rendered 10s visual review.
Forest form, distribution, and seasonal appearance are inferred; individual canopy coordinates are not survey claims.
